As we see, the mean grade has been calculated to be 60. That is a considerable drop from the
original mean that was 82 in example 1. The population mean 82 was typical of the first 5 scores in
the data set, but does the number 60 represent a typical score for the 7 students on this test?
Checking the data, we note there were no scores close to 60. Look at the dot plot for the data in
. Do you think the mean value of 60 is typical of the data?
: Dot plot for data in Tables 2. Does the mean still represent a typical value?
From the dot plot, it appears that the mean is in the middle, as it should be, but it doesn’t represent
the typical observation anymore. Over half of the scores were 80 or higher, and most were 70 or
higher. The typical grade letter grade was a B, and no exam score was near 60.
how the inclusion of the extremely low data values caused the mean to drop in such a way that it no
